error_description: The response favored CT before lumbar puncture based on age and confusion without sufficiently distinguishing the severity of impaired consciousness or other neurological indications.
potential_harm: Unnecessary neuroimaging and delayed CSF diagnosis.
positive_findings: Antibiotics not delayed for CT or lumbar puncture
evidence_sources: Tunkel et al., Clinical Infectious Diseases, 2004
van de Beek et al., Clinical Microbiology and Infection, 2016
Klein et al., Neurological Research and Practice, 2023
de Gans and van de Beek, New England Journal of Medicine, 2002
Brouwer et al., Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 2015
Hasbun et al., New England Journal of Medicine, 2001
Køster-Rasmussen et al., Journal of Infection, 2008
evaluation_conclusion: Generally appropriate emergency management with one moderate clinical limitation. Provisional PASS under the ClariSafe decision rules.
